criteria.pass: NISAR L2 GCOV VALIDATED, track 151 descending, frame 70, CRID P05036, cycle 035 (expected 15 Nov 2026 ~16:24 UTC)
criteria.metric: per brightened object: dHH_BC = 10*log10(mean gamma0_C / mean gamma0_B) over object pixels valid on A, B and C; recovery R = -dHH_BC / dHH_AB (1 = fully back to 22 Oct, 0 = stayed bright)
criteria.P1_aggregate: over all brightened-object pixels pooled: 10*log10(sum C / sum B) <= -0.5 * aggregate dHH_AB
criteria.P2_median: median recovery R across brightened objects >= 0.5
criteria.P3_control: urban control |dHH_BC| <= 0.5 dB (otherwise the pass is not comparable -> inconclusive)
criteria.verdict: P1 and P2 met -> WETTING dominant (confirmed); median R < 0.25 -> PERSISTENT (roughness/ploughing dominant); otherwise MIXED
criteria.per_object_labels: R >= 0.5 'dried back (wetting)'; R < 0.25 'stayed bright (roughness/ploughing or other)'; else 'partial'
void_if: the cycle-035 granule is missing, not VALIDATED, or not on the identical grid
it rained again: NASA SMAP at Ceyhan (any recommended-quality retrieval 14-16 Nov) >= 0.25 m3/m3, or, if SMAP has none, NASA POWER >= 10 mm over 12-15 Nov
